method: Live in-app Chromium computed foreground/background/pseudo-placeholder and keyboard outline colors before and after CSS HMR; sRGB relative luminance and (Lmax+0.05)/(Lmin+0.05), no rounding for threshold checks
propagation: Vanilla shared CSS also serves React/Svelte; matching SvelteKit example and standalone guide CSS updated. Npm unused hint rule is aligned to #586c61 but no live hint node was measured.

verification.browser: All seven observed color pairs exceed their selected threshold; CSS HMR retained focused name and npm opener; keyboard form input, modal opening, confirmation typing, Tab/Return closing and focus restoration worked in both demos; console warnings/errors were empty

packageDryRun.note: Workspace JSON is keyed by package name; the first local inspection assumed an array and failed before being corrected. No artifact was installed or published in this slice.

verification.cleanup: Both owned servers stopped and browser tabs closed; original catalogs untouched

limits: Seven scoped color pairs, not full WCAG conformance or assistive-technology certification
Other browsers, forced colors, all UI states and actual low-vision users not tested
React/Svelte/SvelteKit browser matrix and standalone installs not rerun for CSS-only edits; prior unchanged JS behavior results retained
No package API, version, push or publication changes
